text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: gpu-pool-2 queue length 1,240 (5m avg) — autoscaler attempted scale but failed: quotaExceeded. Active long-tail requests spiking. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/obs/d/gpu-pool-2?q=queue_length

jordan (eng-runtime): paging @sam oncall — seeing huge queue growth in gpu-pool-2, correlated with a model-v12 rollout about 10m ago. KV-cache sizes jumping, per-request memory up ~3x.

sam (eng-sre, on-call): on it. I'm pulling logs and the autoscaler events. tagging @lee in case infra quota is the blocker.

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: model-service@v12.2.1 by @alex — rollout started 1758412280, strategy=canary 10%. Release notes: "v12 change: context caching refactor, eager kv prefill".

lee (eng-infra): confirmed: GCE quota for gpu instances in account-redwood-prod is at 79/80. Autoscaler attempted to add 6, failed with quotaExceeded.\\nEvent excerpt:
```
Error scaling cluster: googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded. Requested 6, available 1.
```

jordan (eng-runtime): logs show average context length per request jumped from ~4k tokens to ~18k tokens on v12 canary traffic. KV-cache warmup and larger prefills look like the culprit — many requests keep long-lived KV entries, preventing eviction and increasing memory footprint.

sam (eng-sre, on-call): immediate mitigation plan: 1) Pause further v12 canary ramps, 2) Add fallback routing to model-v11 for new sessions, 3) Temporarily throttle large-context requests, 4) Request quota bump from cloud. Who can pause the rollout? @alex

alex (eng-platform): pausing canary now. Pinned traffic for model-service back to v11 for 95% of traffic. Will open rollback if we still see pressure.

maria (support): any customer-impact so far? I'm seeing a small spike in 502/504 for enterprise tenants hitting heavy chat contexts. Need message to affected customers if this persists.

sam (eng-sre, on-call): observed 502 spike: error-rate up 1.8% on top 20 tenants with long sessions. Latency p95 for gpu-pool-2 jumped from 220ms to 2.4s.

jordan (eng-runtime): running quick query of model-service traces, root cause looks like memory pressure causing eviction thrash and request queueing on gpus. KV-cache warmup isn't respecting max-kv-bytes per session in v12.

lee (eng-infra): quota request filed to cloud support (case 3245123). ETA unknown. Short-term we can: A) move some low-priority pools to CPU fallback, B) evict non-critical workloads from gpu-pool-2, C) spawn smaller GPU instances if available in other regions and route.

sam (eng-sre, on-call): doing C now — triggering cross-region spill to gpu-pool-3 if latency budget allows. Command:
```
# route canary/overflow to pool-3
redwoodctl route update --service model-service --overflow-pool gpu-pool-3 --max-latency-ms 800
```

devops (ops-bot): Route update accepted. Starting warmup on gpu-pool-3. 48 instances requested.

jordan (eng-runtime): also flipping a safety throttle on model-service: cap context tokens to 12k for new sessions and add a soft reject (429) for >15k to prevent immediate re-queue. Patch applied to edge layer: `edge-config/v12-token-throttle`

sam (eng-sre, on-call): autoscaler rescan requested. Running `gke-autoscaler probe --cluster prod-gpu --force` now.

lee (eng-infra): autoscaler probe shows nodes provisionable in pool-3 but image warmup needed for model-v11 runtime so cold starts may add ~30s. We're bootstrapping faster by pre-pulling container images.

maria (support): drafting customer note: "We detected elevated latencies and intermittent errors for some long-context requests due to a new model rollout. We've reverted canary traffic, applied throttles, and are routing overflow to additional capacity. We'll follow up with impact summary." Send to me for sign-off.

alex (eng-platform): confirming traffic rollback done. Canary flag removed at 1758412402. All new sessions should be hitting v11.

sam (eng-sre, on-call): queue length trending down: 1,240 -> 520 in 6m. Autoscaler still showing failures to reach desired because quota pending. Cross-region spill handling absorbing ~400 QPS.

jordan (eng-runtime): opened a hotfix PR to cap kv-prefill size per session in v12 and to add a configurable eviction threshold. PR: https://github.com/redwood/model-service/pull/4892 — will merge to canary branch after tests.

devops (ops-bot): quota case updated: cloud support requests justification and expects 2–4h for review. Reference: case 3245123.

lee (eng-infra): interim step: evict low-priority batch jobs from gpu-pool-2. Command run: `gcloud compute instances delete --filter=\"labels=low-priority\" --zone=us-west1-b --quiet` — freed 6 GPUs. Autoscaler re-evaluating.

sam (eng-sre, on-call): autoscaler succeeded in adding 4 GPUs after the manual free. Queue down to 180. p95 latency back to ~320ms.

maria (support): customer-impact update: affected tenants — list attached to the ticket. Notifying top 5 enterprise customers with mitigation summary and ETA for root cause fix.

alex (eng-platform): let's keep v12 paused until kv-prefill cap is in place and we've validated memory footprint on a private staging pool. DO NOT resume rollout without an approved memory profile.

jordan (eng-runtime): agreed. I'll run a targeted perf test with synthetic long-context traces against a staging cluster with v12+hotfix. Expected run 30m. Posting results here.

sam (eng-sre, on-call): creating incident ticket I-2026-0588 and assigning P1. On-call takeover log saved. Handoff to lee for infra follow-ups and to jordan for runtime code fix.

lee (eng-infra): taking infra lead. I'll coordinate with cloud support for quota bump and monitor cross-region spill.

jordan (eng-runtime): taking runtime lead. Will iterate hotfix and validate.

maria (support): will keep customers updated and prepare postmortem blurb.

sam (eng-sre, on-call): summary so far: cause = v12 changes increased per-session KV-cache and context lengths -> memory pressure -> autoscaler hit GPU quota -> queueing and throttling -> transient errors. Mitigations = pause rollout, throttle big sessions, route overflow, free low-priority GPUs, request quota bump. Next steps = merge and validate hotfix, rehearse canary on staging, prepare PSR.

jordan (eng-runtime): noted. I'll post after hotfix test completes.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity=P1, status=mitigated->partial. Next update in 30m or on new developments.

sam (eng-sre, on-call): closing loop here for the channel — switching to Incident War Room at #incident-warroom-I-2026-0588 for real-time coordination. If you are not in that room, follow the incident ticket.
